gamerule.truehealamp.description: Sets the amplifier of the true heal effect. Default: 0
gamerule.truehealdelay.description: Sets the duration of the pre_healing effect in ticks. Default: 100.
gamerule.truehealcd.description: If true, mobs will be interrupted from healing when hurt. Default: true.
gamerule.truehealtime.description: Extra time in ticks added onto the duration of the true heal effect. Default: 200.
